reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Hawaii
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Are damages available to a tenant who is unlawfully evicted?
*/

% -------------------------
% Scenario facts (question)
% -------------------------

state(hawaii).
focus_year(2021).

party(landlord1).
party(tenant1).
premises(premises1).

rental_relationship(landlord1, tenant1, premises1).

% Factual statement encoded: "unlawfully evicted"
% We model this as: landlord removed/excluded tenant overnight, without cause, and without court order.
removed_or_excluded_overnight(landlord1, tenant1, premises1).
removal_without_cause(landlord1, tenant1, premises1).
removal_without_court_order(landlord1, tenant1, premises1).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the scenario statement is satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    state(hawaii),
    focus_year(2021),
    rental_relationship(Landlord, Tenant, Premises),
    removed_or_excluded_overnight(Landlord, Tenant, Premises),
    removal_without_cause(Landlord, Tenant, Premises),
    removal_without_court_order(Landlord, Tenant, Premises).

% ---------------------------------------
% Statute translations (deterministic)
% ---------------------------------------

/*
  HI Rev Stat  521-63(c) (2021):
  If landlord removes/excludes tenant overnight without cause or without court order,
  tenant may recover possession or terminate and, in either case, recover:
  - amount equal to two months rent or free occupancy for two months, and
  - cost of suit including reasonable attorney's fees.
  Court may also order injunctive/equitable relief.
*/

% 521-63(c): Condition for tenant remedy to apply (unlawful removal/exclusion).
% Deterministic: succeeds at most once per (L,T,P).
legal_521_63_c_unlawful_removal_exclusion(Landlord, Tenant, Premises) :-
    removed_or_excluded_overnight(Landlord, Tenant, Premises),
    ( removal_without_cause(Landlord, Tenant, Premises)
    ; removal_without_court_order(Landlord, Tenant, Premises)
    ),
    !.

% 521-63(c): Tenant may recover a monetary amount (two months rent OR two months free occupancy).
% We represent the availability of money recovery as a "damage_item/1".
legal_521_63_c_money_recovery_available(Landlord, Tenant, Premises, damage_item(two_months_rent_or_two_months_free_occupancy)) :-
    legal_521_63_c_unlawful_removal_exclusion(Landlord, Tenant, Premises),
    rental_relationship(Landlord, Tenant, Premises),
    !.

% 521-63(c): Tenant may also recover cost of suit including reasonable attorney's fees.
legal_521_63_c_costs_and_fees_available(Landlord, Tenant, Premises, damage_item(cost_of_suit_including_reasonable_attorney_fees)) :-
    legal_521_63_c_unlawful_removal_exclusion(Landlord, Tenant, Premises),
    rental_relationship(Landlord, Tenant, Premises),
    !.

% A general "damages available" predicate derived from 521-63(c).
% Deterministic for a given Tenant in this file's scenario.
damages_available_to_tenant_under_statute(Tenant) :-
    rental_relationship(Landlord, Tenant, Premises),
    ( legal_521_63_c_money_recovery_available(Landlord, Tenant, Premises, _)
    ; legal_521_63_c_costs_and_fees_available(Landlord, Tenant, Premises, _)
    ),
    !.

% -------------------------
% Answer derivation
% -------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    damages_available_to_tenant_under_statute(tenant1),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

% -------------------------
% Main entrypoint
% -------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Are damages available to a tenant who is unlawfully evicted?
